tha-ap256:1.1: Ticampakapupphiya.] Himavantass' avidūre Vikaṭo nāma pabbato / tassa vemajjhe vasati samaṇo bhāvitindriyo. // //
tha-ap256:2.1: Disvāna tassopasamaṃ vippasannena cetasā / tīṇi campakapupphāni gahetvāna samokiriṃ. // //
tha-ap256:3.1: Ekanavute ito kappe yaṃ puppham abhipūjayiṃ / duggatiṃ nābhijānāmi Buddhapūjāy' idaṃ phalaṃ. // //
tha-ap256:5.1: Itthaṃ sudam āyasmā Ticampakapupphiyo thero i. g. a-ti.
